userContent.text:
Build an interactive 2D figure from the brief below and the source image.

AUTHORED FIGURE BRIEF:
This figure stacks five drawings of the same fixed string. At the top a horizontal line runs between two black endpoint dots, each labeled "Node", with a double-headed dimension arrow above it labeled L. Beneath come four standing-wave patterns on lines of that same length, labeled at the left n = 1, n = 2, n = 3, and n = 4. Each is a dark blue curve with a pale mirror-image curve, the two outlining the envelope the string sweeps, ends pinned and interior crossing points rising from none to three. Two expressions sit to the right of each: 1/2 lambda_1 = L and lambda_1 = 2/1 L, then lambda_2 = L and lambda_2 = 2/2 L, then 3/2 lambda_3 = L and lambda_3 = 2/3 L, then 4/2 lambda_4 = L and lambda_4 = 2/4 L. A general statement closes the lower right, lambda_n = 2/n L for n = 1, 2, 3, and so on. Holding one length fixed while packing in more half-wavelengths shows how the pinned ends restrict which wavelengths fit. The sequence introduces the normal modes of a string fixed at both ends.

REQUESTED INTERACTIONS:
- Button/state for mode number: the learner steps through n = 1, 2, 3, and 4, the standing-wave shape, interior nodes, and wavelength equation update, making clear that exactly n half-wavelengths must fit inside length L.
- Animation for the selected mode: the learner presses play for any mode, the string oscillates between the two envelope curves while endpoint and interior nodes stay fixed, making clear the difference between nodes and antinodes.
- Slider for string length L: the learner drags the endpoint separation, the displayed wavelength for the selected mode stretches or contracts with the string, making clear the relationship lambda_n = 2L/n.

SOURCE FILE: OpenStax University Physics, chapter 16: Waves

There is no blueprint: decide the figure type, elements, labels, controls, and any step sequence yourself.

outputText:
Select a mode (or click a wave) and press Animate. The fixed ends are nodes; the bulging points are antinodes. Drag L to see λₙ = 2L/n stretch.

// @FIGURE_CODE_BEGIN // Library: svgjs (function () { var W = 760, H = 560; var draw = SVG().addTo(document.getElementById('container')).size('100%', '100%'); draw.viewbox(0, 0, W, H); var X0 = 80, SCALE = 150, AMP = 30, NSAMP = 140; var TOP_Y = 70, ARROW_Y = 40; var ROW_Y = [150, 250, 350, 450]; var EQ_X = 548; var L = 2.0, selN = 1, playing = false, animId = null, t0 = null; var phases = { 1: 1, 2: 1, 3: 1, 4: 1 }; var gHi = draw.group(); var gTop = draw.group(); var gWaves = draw.group(); var gBracket = draw.group(); var gEq = draw.group(); function stringPx() { return L * SCALE; } function halo(t) { return t.attr({ 'paint-order': 'stroke', stroke: '#fff', 'stroke-width': 3, 'stroke-linejoin': 'round' }); } function arrowH(g, x1, x2, y, color) { color = color || '#111'; g.line(x1, y, x2, y).stroke({ color: color, width: 1.3 }); g.polygon((x1 + 7) + ',' + (y - 3.5) + ' ' + x1 + ',' + y + ' ' + (x1 + 7) + ',' + (y + 3.5)).fill(color); g.polygon((x2 - 7) + ',' + (y - 3.5) + ' ' + x2 + ',' + y + ' ' + (x2 - 7) + ',' + (y + 3.5)).fill(color); } function wavePoints(n, phi) { var sp = stringPx(), top = [], bot = [], dark = []; for (var i = 0; i <= NSAMP; i++) { var s = i / NSAMP; var x = X0 + s * sp; var env = AMP * Math.sin(n * Math.PI * s); top.push([x, ROW_Y[n - 1] - env]); bot.push([x, ROW_Y[n - 1] + env]); dark.push([x, ROW_Y[n - 1] - env * phi]); } return { top: top, bot: bot, dark: dark }; } function pts(a) { return a.map(function (p) { return p[0].toFixed(1) + ',' + p[1].toFixed(1); }).join(' '); } function drawWaveRow(n) { var y = ROW_Y[n - 1], sp = stringPx(); var sel = (n === selN); var p = wavePoints(n, phases[n]); var pale = sel ? '#b9c8dd' : '#c4d2e6'; gWaves.polyline(pts(p.top)).fill('none').stroke({ color: pale, width: 1.6, linecap: 'round' }); gWaves.polyline(pts(p.bot)).fill('none').stroke({ color: pale, width: 1.6, linecap: 'round' }); gWaves.polyline(pts(p.dark)).fill('none').stroke({ color: '#2b5c8a', width: 2.4, linecap: 'round', linejoin: 'round' }); // endpoint + interior nodes (fixed points) for (var j = 0; j <= n; j++) { var x = X0 + (j / n) * sp; gWaves.circle(6).center(x, y).fill('#111'); } // invisible hover/click band var band = gWaves.rect(sp + 12, AMP * 2 + 16).center(X0 + sp / 2, y).fill('transparent'); band.css('cursor', 'pointer'); band.on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('Mode n = ' + n + ': ' + n + ' half-wavelength' + (n > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' fit in L. Black dots are nodes (never move); the bulges are antinodes (max motion).', e); }); band.on('mouseleave', hideTooltip); band.on('click', function () { selectMode(n); }); } function leftEqStr(n) { if (n === 1) return '½ λ₁ = L'; if (n === 2) return 'λ₂ = L'; return (n + '/2') + ' λ' + sub(n) + ' = L'; } function rightEqStr(n) { return 'λ' + sub(n) + ' = 2/' + n + ' L'; } function sub(n) { return ['₀', '₁', '₂', '₃', '₄'][n]; } function renderTop() { gTop.clear(); var sp = stringPx(), x1 = X0 + sp; gTop.line(X0, TOP_Y, x1, TOP_Y).stroke({ color: '#2b5c8a', width: 2 }); gTop.circle(7).center(X0, TOP_Y).fill('#111'); gTop.circle(7).center(x1, TOP_Y).fill('#111'); halo(gTop.text('Node').center(X0, TOP_Y + 18).font({ size: 13, family: 'sans-serif' })); halo(gTop.text('Node').center(x1, TOP_Y + 18).font({ size: 13, family: 'sans-serif' })); // dimension arrow gTop.line(X0, ARROW_Y - 6, X0, ARROW_Y + 6).stroke({ color: '#111', width: 1 }); gTop.line(x1, ARROW_Y - 6, x1, ARROW_Y + 6).stroke({ color: '#111', width: 1 }); arrowH(gTop, X0, x1, ARROW_Y, '#111'); halo(gTop.text('L').center(X0 + sp / 2, ARROW_Y - 12).font({ size: 15, family: 'serif', style: 'italic' })); } function renderEq() { gEq.clear(); for (var n = 1; n <= 4; n++) { var y = ROW_Y[n - 1]; var sel = (n === selN); halo(gEq.text('n = ' + n).move(8, y - 8).font({ size: 15, family: 'serif', style: 'italic', weight: sel ? 'bold' : 'normal' })); var col = sel ? '#1d4e79' : '#333'; halo(gEq.text(leftEqStr(n)).move(EQ_X, y - 9).font({ size: 14, family: 'serif', style: 'italic', weight: sel ? 'bold' : 'normal' }).fill(col)); var rstr = rightEqStr(n); if (sel) rstr += ' = ' + (2 * L / n).toFixed(2) + ' m'; halo(gEq.text(rstr).move(EQ_X + 130, y - 9).font({ size: 14, family: 'serif', style: 'italic', weight: sel ? 'bold' : 'normal' }).fill(col)); } halo(gEq.text('λₙ = 2/n L n = 1, 2, 3, …').move(EQ_X + 20, 520).font({ size: 15, family: 'serif', style: 'italic', weight: 'bold' }).fill('#111')); } function renderHighlight() { gHi.clear(); var y = ROW_Y[selN - 1]; gHi.rect(W - 16, AMP * 2 + 30).center(W / 2, y).radius(8).fill('#eaf2fb').stroke({ color: '#bcd6f0', width: 1 }); } function renderBracket() { gBracket.clear(); var n = selN, sp = stringPx(), y = ROW_Y[n - 1] + AMP + 22; var lamPx = (2 * L / n) * SCALE; var span, label; if (lamPx > sp + 1) { span = sp; label = '½ λ' + sub(n) + ' = L'; } else { span = lamPx; label = 'λ' + sub(n) + ' = ' + (2 * L / n).toFixed(2) + ' m'; } arrowH(gBracket, X0, X0 + span, y, '#c0392b'); halo(gBracket.text(label).center(X0 + span / 2, y + 14).font({ size: 12, family: 'serif', style: 'italic' }).fill('#c0392b')); } function renderWaves() { gWaves.clear(); for (var n = 1; n <= 4; n++) drawWaveRow(n); } function renderAll() { renderHighlight(); renderTop(); renderWaves(); renderBracket(); renderEq(); } // ---- interaction handlers (global) ---- window.selectMode = function (n) { selN = n; for (var i = 1; i <= 4; i++) { var b = document.getElementById('m' + i); if (b) b.classList.toggle('active', i === n); if (i !== n) phases[i] = 1; } if (!playing) phases[n] = 1; renderAll(); }; window.togglePlay = function () { playing = !playing; var btn = document.getElementById('playBtn'); if (playing) { btn.textContent = '❚❚ Pause'; t0 = null; animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop); } else { btn.textContent = '▶ Animate mode'; if (animId) cancelAnimationFrame(animId); phases[selN] = 1; renderWaves(); } }; function loop(ts) { if (!playing) return; if (t0 === null) t0 = ts; var el = (ts - t0) / 1000; phases[selN] = Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * 0.6 * el); renderWaves(); animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop); } window.update_L = function (v) { L = v; renderAll(); }; renderAll(); window.__markRendered(); })(); // @FIGURE_CODE_END
